parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this and for flagging it as confidential. We’re treating it as a potential cross-tenant access issue and we’ve escalated it to our security team for investigation.

At this stage we haven’t confirmed whether any tenant data was actually accessed via the forwarded link. To help us validate what’s happening, could you please share the following details (if available):
1) Product area/feature that generates these report links (e.g., “Share report link” / “Publish report” / specific module).
2) Whether the recipient in the other workspace can view the report data itself, or only sees link/metadata (or an error message).
3) The exact steps to reproduce, including how the URL is forwarded and how the recipient opens it (including whether they are signed in).
4) Whether this occurs consistently or only under certain conditions (specific report type, roles, environments, etc.).
5) The relevant tenant/workspace identifiers (or anonymized IDs) for both the link creator and the workspace that unexpectedly shows the link.
6) Any audit/log entries you can provide showing who created the link and when it was opened.

If you’re able, please also avoid further distribution of the forwarded link while we investigate, since it may bypass intended tenant boundaries.

We’ll review the provided information and follow up with next steps as soon as we can. In the meantime, if you can share the reproduction steps and what the recipient can/can’t see, that will help us prioritize the investigation.
promised_actions: Escalate the report to the security team for investigation
Review the details you provide and follow up with next steps
safety_notes: Do not claim confirmation of exfiltration or cross-tenant access; only indicate investigation.
Ask for minimum useful clarification to determine impact (data vs metadata visibility), reproduction steps, and relevant identifiers/logs.
Avoid promising a fix, refund, SLA, or definitive root cause/security determination.

Whether the other workspace recipients can actually view the underlying report data or only see the existence/metadata of the link.
